data.one_liner: A streaming JSON parser optimized for parsing LLM responses incrementally.
data.what_it_does: Parses JSON character-by-character as it streams in from LLM responses. Allows path-based subscriptions to properties so you can receive values chunk-by-chunk or await complete values without waiting for the entire response to finish.
use_when: You need to display streaming LLM text responses or JSON data in real-time.
You want to avoid UI jumps by populating lists and maps progressively as they begin parsing.
avoid_when: You are parsing standard static JSON files where traditional jsonDecode() is sufficient.
strengths: Processes incomplete JSON fragments chunk-by-chunk without throwing errors.
Provides both streams (for live typing effects) and futures (for atomic values) on every property.
Includes robust handling for escape sequences, unicode, and large arrays.
weaknesses: Adds overhead compared to built-in JSON decoding if streaming is not required.
